findings.where: ep06.md 人数表 vs 仮ショット割り
findings.what: The summary table declares 's05a〜s22 = population 2', but the shot column assigns 1 to s08, s09, s11, s16, s19a, s19b and 0 to s10, s20. Eight shots contradict the summary.
findings.why: Two tables in one document are two sources of truth; the records will disagree.
findings.fix: Rewrite the summary to the real ranges (s05a–s07, s12–s15, s17–s18, s21–s22 = 2; s08/09/11/16/19a/b = 1; s10/20 = 0), or drop it and point at the column.

findings.where: ep06.md s03/s04/s08 (耳の寄り), s15 (指の腹/手首)
findings.what: Close-ups holding only part of a body declare no body_parts, and 'ear' is not in specmap.BODY_PARTS.
findings.why: A partial body must declare body_parts (L52); the ear shots have no registered part word.
findings.fix: Declare {head}/{face} for the ear shots, {hand}/{finger} for s15, and record the missing 'ear' token as a hole.

findings.where: ep06.md key_image (114)・未決#2 vs scene ep06 prompt
findings.what: The ep06 board is assigned to s05a (花 coming), but the board depicts 花 already standing on the near pan being weighed — that is s06/s07.
findings.why: The reuse does not support the shot it is pinned to; 未決#2 flags it as 'look before baking', but the mismatch is content-level (one beat later).
findings.fix: Retarget the reuse to s06 or s07 and burn a new s05a, or drop the reuse; recompute the count (25 new / 24 attached).

findings.what: The scale is referenced by prop sheet #13 (cel-shade), while all 25 key_images are one-lamp-cel; the scale is on-screen in ~12 shots and must be re-rendered from a cel-shade sheet.
findings.why: This is the consistency risk inside the 24-new load; no one-lamp-cel appearance asset.
findings.fix: Paste a one-lamp-cel appearance line for the scale into each scale shot's prompt, and check the plate before batch-burning.

findings.what: one-lamp-cel has no Motion character; L20 fires on all 25 shots.
findings.why: A declared residual, understood and sequenced.
findings.fix: Get the author's ruling before staging, or record L20 per shot.

note: ep06 is a clean no-memory episode with a single place/time and a fixed 25-shot cut; 24 new key_images is feasible. The blocking defects are internal consistency: the population summary contradicts the shot column, body_parts are undecided for the close-ups (and 'ear' is not in the vocabulary), and the s05a reuse is a one-beat content mismatch.
